scope: Curated batch-video lifecycle and premium product-launch production catalog. 29 baseline entries plus 16 capture, spatial, motion, skill and finishing additions. Not an exhaustive index or an output-quality guarantee.
privacy: Generic public-safe research only; personal preferences and account readiness belong in private configuration.
licensing_note: Code, weights, dependencies, sample data, footage, music and outputs may have different terms. This is a technical inventory, not legal clearance.
verification_note: Repository URLs, detected licences and selected current commits were read from GitHub. Capabilities and constraints come from official READMEs/documentation. No new model benchmark or install performed by this research.
